blogs.title: xLSTM 101: Why Modern LSTMs are Still Killing It in Language Models
blogs.description: A beginner‑friendly guide that demystifies the core innovations of xLSTM—exponential gating and matrix memory—explaining how they solve classic LSTM pain points and bring performance on par with Transformers while keeping linear time and memory.

blogs.title: Co‑existing Memories: sLSTM vs. mLSTM – One Is Scalar, the Other Matrix, Both Are Game‑Changers
blogs.description: An in‑depth comparison of the two new LSTM variants. Readers will learn the practical trade‑offs between scalar and matrix memories, why parallelism matters for mLSTM, and when you should pick one over the other in your own projects.

blogs.title: Memory Mixing Made Easy – How Exponential Gating Lets Recurrent Nets Track States Like Never Before
blogs.description: A deeper look at why traditional LSTMs can’t revise past decisions and how xLSTM’s exponential gates, with their stabilizer trick, give the model a true state‑tracking capability—vital for tasks like code execution or narrative coherence.

blogs.title: Scaling to 16K Tokens: xLSTM’s Linear Speed vs. Transformers’ Quadratic Bottleneck
blogs.description: An accessible comparison of inference throughput and training cost, showing how xLSTM keeps constant memory per token and scales linearly with sequence length, while Transformers choke on long contexts – all backed by real benchmark numbers.

blogs.title: From Small Blocks to Big Models – The Anatomy of an xLSTM Architecture
blogs.description: Walkthrough of residual backbones, pre/post up‑projection blocks, and how to stack sLSTM/mLSTM cells into a full LLM. Includes diagram sketches and practical tips for implementing xLSTM in PyTorch or JAX.

blogs.title: xLSTM in Action: Benchmarking on Real Language Tasks (PALOMA, Downstream Reasoning)
blogs.description: Explains how to evaluate a language model on diverse datasets, interpreting perplexity curves across 571 domains, and highlights where xLSTM outperforms leading Transformers and State‑Space models in real‑world text generation.

blogs.title: Future Proofing AI: Why Recurrent Architectures Like xLSTM Are Here to Stay
blogs.description: A forward‑looking piece discussing the limitations of attention‑heavy models on edge devices, energy budgets, and explainability, positioning xLSTM as an attractive alternative for long‑term deployment.
